remove.title: Confirm removal

data.mic_https_url: Home Assistant HTTPS URL for microphone (optional)

settings.description: To use the microphone when Home Assistant was opened via a local HTTP address, enter its existing HTTPS URL (for example https://ha.example.com). Leave empty to use the Home Assistant internal/external HTTPS URL automatically. When pressing the mic on HTTP, P2Talk opens the HTTPS panel before recording.
